eli5.text: The Terms of Service still describe the exact same service at codebuff.com, but the legal name on the page changed from "Codebuff, Inc" to "Manicode, Inc. (DBA Codebuff)". This is purely a corporate renaming behind the scenes to match the company's actual legal entity. Users will notice nothing about their experience, payments, or access since it only updates how the business is formally identified in the legal text. The change is live now since visitors can read the updated Terms of Service page.
